From: Samir Bedi <samir@uplift.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 May 2025 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood demo request (self-serve signup)

Hi Grace,

I signed up through Redwood earlier this morning — thanks for making the self-serve flow so fast. We're evaluating options to power an on-site conversational assistant and semantic product search for our storefront. High level:
- Use case: product discovery + conversational upsell (search + chat hybrid)
- Expected volume: ~15 million requests / month (search & chat combined), spiky traffic with Black Friday-style bursts (3–6x baseline)
- Peak concurrency: ~30 qps sustained during bursts; baseline around 6–8 qps
- Typical request size: ~450 tokens in / ~300 tokens out average (some long chat sessions)
- Timeline: aim to kick off a 6–8 week pilot, with a production decision after the pilot
- Compliance: some user PII (emails/order ids) but not PCI; interested in SOC2 evidence and VPC/private options later

I've attached a sample traffic export (traffic_snapshot.csv) that shows hourly peaks and token distribution. Would love to book a 30-min walkthrough to: confirm fit, run through expected latency/cost tradeoffs, and ask about Dedicated vs hosted pricing for our profile. We can be flexible with times — we do run heavy jobs overnight / weekends (UTC-7/PST), so odd-hour availability is important.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Bedi
Head of Platform
Uplift AI
attachments: traffic_snapshot.csv (CSV, 120KB)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>

Hi Samir — great to meet you over email and thanks for the detailed snapshot.

Quick clarifying questions so we can make the demo productive:
- Is the 15M requests/month figure counting each chat turn as one request, or are you counting sessions (i.e., multiple turns)?
- Do the peaks you mentioned happen predictably (e.g., daily overnight jobs) or are they event-driven/spikey (marketing blasts)?
- Any hard latency SLOs for tail p95/p99 we should know about (e.g., <200ms p95 for search)?
- Are you evaluating for hosted first and Dedicated later, or is Dedicated a hard requirement for the pilot?

If you can answer those, I can tailor the walkthrough and invite the right infra folks. Please propose 3 slots that work for you (we can accommodate odd hours — we have engineers who can join early/late PST). Some quick options from our side: 2025-05-14 10:30am PST, 2025-05-15 6:00pm PST, or 2025-05-16 2:00am PST (we realize that last one is early; including in case your batch windows are overnight).

I attached a short pilot-readiness checklist that helps us scope the call. If you'd rather I just drop a calendar link, I can do that as well.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
attachments: pilot-readiness-checklist.pdf (PDF, 45KB)
From: Samir Bedi <samir@uplift.ai>

Date: Wed, 7 May 2025 09:00:00 -0700

Hi Grace — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below:
- 15M counts each API call (each chat turn counts as one request in our telemetry).
- Peaks are a mix: predictable nightly enrichment jobs (start ~midnight PST, run 2–4 hours) plus event-driven spikes for promo blasts (unpredictable).
- Latency goal: p95 < 250ms for search requests; p99 < 500ms is desirable but not a hard blocker for the pilot.
- We want to try hosted first for the pilot to accelerate onboarding, but Dedicated is likely for production if perf/cost lines up.

Availability: we can do the 2025-05-14 10:30am PST slot you suggested, or 2025-05-15 6:00pm PST. The overnight 2:00am slot is probably overkill for this first meeting.

Let me know what works and we will accept the invite.

—Samir
